I am Dr. Agent. To begin my assessment of your mental status changes, have you experienced any recent fever, headache, or stiff neck? 

REQUEST TEST: Complete_Blood_Count, Comprehensive_Metabolic_Panel, Toxicology_Screen.

speaker: Doctor
text:
Given your normal blood work, have you been exposed to any insects or ticks recently, or do you recall a specific mosquito bite before your symptoms started?

REQUEST IMAGES: Skin_lesion_close_up

speaker: Patient
text: 48-year-old female. The patient has been brought to the emergency room by her family due to altered mental status. The family mentions that she has been increasingly confused over the past few days. No recent head trauma or known drug use. The patient has a smoking history of 30 pack-years.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Encephalitis. Given the normal blood work, lack of fever, and absence of rash or tick exposure, a central nervous system infection like HSV encephalitis or autoimmune encephalitis remains the primary concern despite the initial workup. I will proceed with a Lumbar Puncture and EEG to confirm.
